title: KW T909 Powder Coated FUPS Aluminium Road Train Bullbar #26
description: KenworthT909 Powder Coated FUPS Hi-tensile Aluminium Road Train Bullbar, 381 style channel with side skirt. Standard 76mm diameter pipe but optional 88mm or 100mm pipe can be ordered. Four post box uprights extended to the bottom cow catcher bar resulting in maximum protection to the bonnet and radiator. Cow catcher and four small uprights. Reversible aluminium Road Train signs, provision for Oversize sign. Provision for front mudflaps. Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin, main channel secured with 4 chrome plated eye bolts for added strength. The bar is fitted with a heavy duty lift assist spring. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements including driving light mounts. Bullbar can be powder coated to a wide range of colours.
